description:
Adonis, Vincent's most beloved servant. Adonis, with his unusually pale complexion and handsome appearance, is visibly discriminated against by the other employees. Furthermore, as Vincent shows affection for him, the employees' harassment intensifies, and Vincent, out of affection, begins to distance himself from Adonis. However, the more Vincent distances himself, the more persistently Adonis pursues him, leading to a stern reprimand from an enraged Vincent. He's clearly scolded, but the child's core seems to bulge—is it just his imagination? Perhaps he's become immersed in Adonis, and every time he sees the marks he's left on his skin, he feels a chill of excitement...!

Am I the one who wants to hit him, the one being cared for by Adonis, or is it Adonis, who's still looking at me with a gleeful face, begging for me to punish him immediately? Feeling his common sense crumbling, Vincent finally gives way to instinct and falls in love with Adonis...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.*
